title: Post-CAS recovery remains landed while preserving later workspace edits as unverified

write.text:
#!/bin/sh
case_dir='{case}'
origin='{origin}'
path_no_wrapper=$(printf '%s' "$PATH" | sed 's|^[^:]*:||')
PATH=$path_no_wrapper
real_git=$(command -v git) || exit 127
"$real_git" "$@"
result=$?
ref_seen=0
new_value=
want_value=0
for arg in "$@"; do
  if [ "$want_value" = 1 ]; then new_value=$arg; break; fi
  if [ "$arg" = refs/heads/main ]; then ref_seen=1; want_value=1; fi
done
if [ "$result" = 0 ] && [ "$ref_seen" = 1 ]; then
  tip=$("$real_git" --git-dir "$origin" rev-parse --verify refs/heads/main 2>/dev/null)
  incoming=$("$real_git" --git-dir "$origin" for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' refs/kogen/incoming/)
  if [ "$tip" = "$new_value" ] && [ -n "$incoming" ]; then
    : > "$case_dir/post-cas"
    while [ ! -f "$case_dir/release-git" ]; do sleep 0.02; done
  fi
fi
exit "$result"

steps.sh: for work in '{state_root}'/{run_id:greet}-*; do if [ -d "$work/.git" ]; then printf 'After CAS work\n' > "$work/lib/post-cas.txt"; fi; done
